name: Gomorrah
overview: Gomorrah was one of the infamous 'cities of the plain,' located near Sodom and other cities, as described in Genesis 10:19 and 13:10. It was ruled by King Birsha, who, along with other kings, was defeated by Chedorlaomer and his allies in a significant battle (Genesis 14:2, 8-9). The city is noted for its great wickedness, which ultimately led to its destruction, a judgment that serves as a solemn warning of God's holiness and justice.
